description: Fault-detection benchmark, current_mA: individually labelled 'isolated_spike' faults.
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC SIMULATED DATASET. Not physical hardware readings. Parameters are documented simulation assumptions and are not verified specifications of the INA219, DS18B20 or any other physical device.

random_seeds.derivation: run_seed = SeedSequence(entropy=seed_roots[partition], spawn_key=(crc32(scenario_id), run_number)).generate_state(1)[0]; the run seed is spawned into 5 independent streams: profile, ambient, DUT noise, reference noise, fault placement.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.description: Scenario (dataset) identifier; spans partitions.

columns.name: experiment_id
columns.description: Unique acquisition session (run); the unit of partitioning.

columns.name: run_id
columns.description: Run label within the scenario (CALnn / VALnn / TSTnn).

columns.name: partition
columns.description: calibration | validation | test (assigned per run).

columns.name: generation_seed
columns.description: Integer seed of the run's random streams.

columns.name: device_id
columns.description: Simulated device-under-test instance.

columns.name: data_source
columns.description: Provenance tag (synthetic_suite_v2).

columns.name: operating_condition_id
columns.description: Planned operating-condition group (e.g. grid_A, grid_B_interleaved, extrapolation_above_cal_range). Never encodes fault presence.

columns.name: setpoint_index
columns.description: Index of the planned set-point/plateau in run order (-1 during ramps).

columns.name: protocol_phase
columns.description: Planned protocol phase (dwell, steady, ramp, plateau_settling, plateau_stable, ...).

columns.name: timestamp_utc
columns.description: Simulated acquisition timestamp (UTC).

columns.name: sequence_number
columns.description: Record counter as transmitted (duplicates/gaps reflect injected record faults).

columns.name: elapsed_ms
columns.description: Milliseconds since run start.

columns.name: current_mA
columns.description: DUT observed (digitised) reading. May be NaN (missing) or +/-inf (non-finite fault).

columns.name: shunt_voltage_mV
columns.description: DUT digitised shunt voltage; current_mA = shunt_voltage_mV / r_shunt_nominal_ohm.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Sensor status code (OK or injected invalid-status code).

columns.name: environmental_temperature_C
columns.description: Simulated ambient-temperature sensor reading.

columns.name: reference_current_mA
columns.description: Simulated independent reference-instrument reading (has its own error model).

columns.name: reference_expanded_uncertainty_k2
columns.description: Stated expanded uncertainty (k=2) of the reference reading.

columns.name: true_current_mA
columns.description: True simulated measurand value (not a measurement).

columns.name: true_environmental_temperature_C
columns.description: True simulated ambient temperature.

columns.name: true_shunt_temperature_C
columns.description: Latent shunt-resistor temperature.

columns.name: true_shunt_resistance_ohm
columns.description: Latent actual shunt resistance.

columns.name: true_shunt_voltage_mV
columns.description: Latent true shunt voltage = true_current_mA * true_shunt_resistance_ohm.

columns.name: true_drift_component
columns.description: Injected gradual-drift contribution to the DUT reading (pre-quantisation).

columns.name: true_injected_error_component
columns.description: Sum of all injected value-domain fault contributions (spike, offset, gain, drift, abrupt).

columns.name: error_vs_true
columns.description: DUT reading minus ground truth.

columns.name: error_vs_reference
columns.description: DUT reading minus reference reading.

columns.name: is_injected_fault
columns.description: True when any injected fault affects this record (compatible with DataQualityAssessor ground_truth_fault_col).

columns.name: label_fault_type
columns.description: ';'-joined injected fault types active on this record, or 'none'.

columns.name: label_fault_event_id
columns.description: ';'-joined fault event ids (see metadata fault_events), or 'none'.

columns.name: label_process_event
columns.description: Genuine (non-fault) process events: setpoint_change, load_step, true_step, ramp_start, or 'none'.

columns.name: dq_flags
columns.description: Flags derivable from observable fields only: MISSING_VALUE, NON_FINITE, STATUS_<code>, DUPLICATE_SEQ, SEQ_GAP_<n>, or NONE.

ground_truth_definitions.true_current_mA: Value of the measurand imposed by the simulation (e.g. calibrator set-point or bath temperature). It is a simulation construct and is never presented as an instrument reading.
ground_truth_definitions.reference_current_mA: Reading of a simulated reference instrument with its own offset, gain, noise, resolution and (temperature only) lag. Use it as a laboratory reference, not as truth.
ground_truth_definitions.error_vs_true: Total DUT error including all modelled effects and injected faults.
ground_truth_definitions.error_vs_reference: Observable calibration error; differs from error_vs_true by the reference error.
ground_truth_definitions.true_shunt_resistance_ohm: Actual shunt resistance including tolerance, TCR and (if modelled) self-heating; the instrument always divides by the nominal value.

parameters.description: Noisier shunt channel with modelled self-heating.

sensor_error_model.equation: R(t) = R_nom*(1+r_shunt_actual_deviation)*(1 + tcr*(T_sh(t) - T_ref)); T_sh[k] = T_sh[k-1] + (1-exp(-dt/tau_th))*(T_amb[k] + R_th*I[k]^2*R[k-1] - T_sh[k-1]), T_sh[0]=T_amb[0] (cold start); V_true = I*R; V_obs = Q( adc_offset_mV + (1+adc_gain_error)*V_true + R_nom*faults + N(0, adc_noise_std_mV) ; adc_quantization_mV ); I_obs = V_obs / R_nom  (mV / Ohm = mA)

fault_magnitude_semantics.isolated_spike: additive value in measurand units, applied to one sample
fault_magnitude_semantics.offset_shift: additive value in measurand units, persistent from onset
fault_magnitude_semantics.gain_change: relative gain change (dimensionless), persistent from onset
fault_magnitude_semantics.gradual_drift: drift rate in measurand units per second, persistent from onset
fault_magnitude_semantics.abrupt_change: additive value in measurand units, applied for 'duration' samples
fault_magnitude_semantics.stuck_signal: no magnitude; the digitised reading is frozen at the last value before onset
fault_magnitude_semantics.missing_samples: no magnitude; value field is empty (NaN)
fault_magnitude_semantics.duplicate_sequence: no magnitude; an exact copy of the record is inserted after it
fault_magnitude_semantics.invalid_status: no magnitude; status field set to a non-OK code

sensor_error_model.parameter_status: Simulation assumptions chosen for benchmark coverage. Not verified specifications of any physical sensor.

reference_error_model.equation: reference = realized_offset + (1 + realized_gain_error) * lag(true, time_constant_s) + N(0, noise_std), quantised to resolution
reference_error_model.stated_uncertainty: reference_expanded_uncertainty_k2 = coverage_k * sqrt(offset_std^2 + (gain_std*|reading|)^2 + noise_std^2 + resolution^2/12); steady-state only, excludes dynamic (lag) error
reference_error_model.note: The reference is a simulated instrument with its own errors; it is NOT ground truth. realized_* values are simulation ground truth about the reference and would be unknown in a real laboratory.

split_strategy.unit_of_partitioning: experiment run (experiment_id); every run belongs to exactly one partition
split_strategy.calibration: fit calibration / tune detector thresholds / train ML models
split_strategy.test: final evaluation only; generated from an independent seed root and, where configured, held-out operating conditions
split_strategy.chronology: run start times are ordered calibration -> validation -> test (one simulated day apart)
split_strategy.within_run_split: not permitted: adjacent samples are correlated (dwell, lag, thermal state)

known_limitations: Synthetic data only; no physical sensor behaviour is claimed.
Noise is white Gaussian; no 1/f noise, interference, or correlated noise between DUT and reference.
Sampling is perfectly periodic (no clock jitter); only injected record faults perturb timing.
The calibrator/source is ideal: the true value equals the planned set-point exactly.
Reference stated uncertainty covers steady-state errors only.
Fault magnitudes and placements are drawn from documented ranges and may not reflect real fault statistics.
Shunt TCR and thermal resistance/time constant are assumed scenario parameters, not measured values.
Self-heating model is first-order and lumped; no PCB heat spreading or airflow effects.
